hero.headline: Software Engineer building data systems and backend apps.
hero.lead: At Daimler Truck, I work on Databricks ETL for 70,000+ trucks, FastAPI web apps, and automated OTA data workflows. I also build Flutter apps for non-profits and run my own Proxmox and Linux lab.

about: I'm a Software Engineer at Daimler Truck Innovation Center India (DTICI) in Bengaluru. After starting out as a trainee focused on analytics and Power BI reporting, I transitioned into software engineering—maintaining Databricks ETL pipelines for ~70,000 connected trucks, replacing legacy BI reports with custom FastAPI and React internal apps, and validating automated Over-The-Air (OTA) data scripts on test rigs.

Outside work, I volunteer as the developer for Udayan Care NGO. I built the bilingual (English & Hindi) FiT-UC mobile app in Flutter using AI-assisted UI workflows alongside a custom Proxmox LXC backend running NocoDB and an auth server at udayan.diivvansh.com. After Google Play testing with Care Leavers on the ground, the app is live with 20–30 monthly active users.

At home, I run and tinker with Linux infrastructure. I started with bare-metal Debian, Kali, and Alpine Linux across spare laptops running Docker Compose, progressed to a 3-node High-Availability Proxmox VE cluster backed up by a 4th laptop running Proxmox Backup Server (PBS), and later consolidated everything onto a single dedicated Proxmox VE 8 server hosting production containers and a K3s cluster.

bulletPoints: Maintain and tune Databricks Spark ETL pipelines processing daily telemetry across ~70,000 connected commercial trucks.
Built a FastAPI + React/Node.js internal web application hosted inside Databricks to replace legacy Power BI dashboards on multi-million-row tables.
Write and validate automated daily Over-The-Air (OTA) fleet data collection scripts on hardware test rigs prior to fleet rollout.
Built and shipped FiT-UC, an aftercare mobile platform for Care Leavers at Udayan Care NGO, live on Google Play Store (20–30 monthly active users).
Developed the bilingual (English & Hindi) Flutter client using AI-assisted UI iteration paired with a self-hosted NocoDB LXC REST backend and Node.js auth server at udayan.diivvansh.com.
Worked closely with the NGO team and field Care Leavers through Google Play closed testing to ship skilling courses, mentor booking, and Red Alert notifications via Gotify.
Automated daily fleet data extraction jobs and reporting workflows across connected commercial vehicles.
Delivered Power BI dashboards and internal cloud data views before transitioning full-time into software engineering.
Automated digital verification test workflows using Python scripts.
Studied SAT solver algorithms for automated problem-solving and explored hardware acceleration models.
Built workforce analytics dashboards in Microsoft Power BI and trained Python forecasting models to analyze workforce trends.
Built a voice-interactive smart mirror by integrating a Raspberry Pi with the Alexa SDK, handling hardware setup, coding, and testing.
Built survey analytics dashboards in Apache Superset and handled data migration across SQL databases, Kobo Toolbox, Glide Apps, Google Sheets, and AppSheet.

evolution.title: Debian, Kali & Alpine on Repurposed Laptops
evolution.summary: Before discovering hypervisors, I ran bare-metal Debian, Kali Linux, and Alpine Linux across spare laptops, orchestrating all self-hosted apps by hand with Docker Engine and Docker Compose.
learnings: Managed Linux networking, firewalling, systemd services, and persistent volume permissions manually.
Used Alpine for lightweight production containers, Debian for host stability, and Kali for local network troubleshooting.
evolution.stack: Debian · Kali Linux · Alpine Linux · Docker · Docker Compose · systemd

evolution.stage: Phase 02 · 3-Node HA Proxmox Cluster + 4th Laptop PBS
evolution.title: Distributed Proxmox VE Quorum & Proxmox Backup Server
evolution.summary: Uncovered Proxmox VE and rebuilt the 4-laptop stack into a 3-node High-Availability (HA) PVE cluster with a dedicated 4th laptop acting exclusively as a Proxmox Backup Server (PBS).
learnings: Learned Corosync quorum voting, split-brain prevention, HA failover groups, and live migration across cluster nodes.
Configured Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) for incremental deduplicated backups, retention policies, and tested disaster recovery restores.
Mastered Linux bridges (vmbr0), thin storage provisioning, and LXC vs KVM workload trade-offs.
evolution.stack: Proxmox VE · Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) · Corosync HA · LXC · KVM

evolution.stage: Phase 03 · Consolidated PVE 8 Host & K3s Cluster
evolution.title: Production NGO LXCs & 6-Node K3s Virtualization Lab
evolution.summary: Consolidated the 4-laptop cluster onto one primary 24/7 Proxmox VE 8 server for lower power draw and unified memory, running production LXC services alongside a 6-node K3s cluster.
learnings: Hosts live Udayan Care NGO production containers (NocoDB LXC, Node.js Auth at udayan.diivvansh.com, Gotify alerts).
Operates a nested 6-node K3s cluster (3 masters + 3 workers) with MetalLB VIPs and Traefik ingress exposed safely via Cloudflare Tunnels and Tailscale.
evolution.stack: Proxmox VE 8 · 6-Node K3s · MetalLB · Traefik · Cloudflare Tunnels · Tailscale

nodes.notes: Replaced 4 individual laptops; hosts Udayan Care production LXCs (NocoDB, Auth, Gotify) and the 6-node K3s cluster.
